caseName: Central Vermont Railway Co. v. Redmond
caseNameFull: Central Vermont Railway Company v. John W. Redmond, Constituting the Public Service Commission of the State of Vermont
attorneys: Mr. C. W. Witters and Mr. George B. Young for the appellant., No appearance for the appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Vermont.

Dismissed with costs, on motion of counsel for the appellant, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the District of Vermont.
